zh: Z 最大只有 500，目标数字和 2·digitSum(Z) 也很小，满足条件的 X 不会离 Z 太远。
既然要的是大于 Z 的最小 X，从 Z+1 开始往上逐个检查即可，第一个满足数字和条件的数就是答案。
先算出 target = 2 × Z 的数字和；令 X = Z + 1，循环判断 X 的数字和（反复取个位并除以 10）是否等于 target，不等就加一，相等即输出 X。
en: Z is at most 500 and the target digit sum 2*digitSum(Z) is small, so the valid X is never far above Z.
Since you want the smallest X greater than Z, just check numbers upward from Z+1; the first one with the required digit sum is the answer.

Compute target = 2 times the digit sum of Z; set X = Z + 1 and loop: compute the digit sum of X (repeatedly take the last digit and divide by 10); if it differs from target increment X, otherwise print X.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate upward from Z+1 and check the digit sum.

## Proof of correctness

The enumeration order is strictly increasing, so the first number that satisfies the condition is the smallest; exhaustive search over the whole domain confirms that a solution always exists in range.

## Complexity

O((X−Z)·digits) time, O(1) space.
